conditional_definitions.scope: Fig4 only; Fig3 standalone squarer is not built
conditional_definitions.paper_sizes: Baseline paper reference only: Table I M1-M9,M11-M13 16u/.18u; M10 32u/.18u; M14 45u/.18u. Active selected sizing differs; see parameters.json and exact verified decks.
conditional_definitions.figure_connectivity: M10 gate connects SQ gate bus of M9/M11/M14 in Fig4, unlike Fig3 where M10 gate connects M2 diode node. Fig4 crossing of gate bus with M1/M2 intermediate node has no dot.
conditional_definitions.bulk: NMOS to GND and PMOS to VDD; figure omits bulk terminals
conditional_definitions.floating_gate: Baseline paper reference: two100fF input capacitors. Active selected C1=1442.0fF,C2=1170.0fF in each M7/M8 instance, each still paralleled by the original1T resistor. Resistor placement remains the existing reproducible DC-convergence interpretation. Intrinsic model parasitics retained.
conditional_definitions.startup: Normal Spectre DC equilibrium before transient; no forced floating gate charge, no startup circuitry, no initial condition. The 1T resistors enforce equal-weight external-input DC average, while transient retains MOS capacitances. This does not independently establish trapped charge QFG=0 in physical fabrication.
conditional_definitions.output_compliance: OUT drain clamped .7V by independent voltage source. Paper does not provide output voltage or loading. Diagnostic .35V compliance run is separate.
conditional_definitions.input: Single scalar current source from Y to X, equivalent to equal and opposite indicated input currents
conditional_definitions.ac: AC magnitude 1A small-signal linearization at +17.5uA DC input by assumption; paper does not give AC operating current. Bias sensitivity saved separately. Zero-bias AC is symmetric and cannot represent full-wave rectification bandwidth.
conditional_definitions.transient: Both text 35uA peak-to-peak (17.5uA peak), and Fig13 ±35uA (35uA peak), 1MHz, preserved separately
conditional_definitions.power: Report VDD-only and sum of VDD,V1,output-compliance source delivered powers. Paper boundary and input condition for static/max not defined. Static evaluated Iin=0 and maximum over ±35uA DC sweep. Input current-source power excluded from these two reported supply sums.
conditional_definitions.linearity: Paper says maximum deviation 11% without formula or normalization. Report maximum |Iout-|Iin|| /35uA fullscale and pointwise deviation for |Iin|>1uA separately; these are not asserted identical to paper metric.
conditional_definitions.process: NN,FF,SS,FS,SF at27C; first letter NMOS,second PMOS per gpdk.scs
conditional_definitions.temperature: NN at -27,0,27,100C from Fig17/18; no Cartesian process-temperature sweep
conditional_definitions.model: Installed gpdk180; paper does not state PDK revision. Nominal NN. gmin=1e-15 to avoid conductance comparable to explicit 1T resistors; all tolerances saved.
conditional_definitions.debug_history: Initial diagnosis used Fig3 M10 gate mapping; superseded run preserved under debug_prefig4_correction and excluded from final comparisons. Corrected native schematic follows Fig4.
